answer: Renewal opens at every beacon tide: each identity must submit a renewal certificate that the network forge signs over its long-term key, and every certificate is stamped into a public timber-mark ledger recording which stake pool funded it. If two marks resolve to one pool, both identities are quarantined until each pays a 40,000 POA release burn or exits the roster. A sybil operator therefore needs a distinct funded pool for every fake identity, and each pool it drains stays permanently cross-linked on the ledger, so the cost of n duplicates is n separable pools plus n irrevocable burns.
